messages:
maria: Planning a fractional rollout for inference-servicer v2.1 tonight 23:30 PT. Expect ~30–60m window depending on smoke. Who can own deploy and smoke checks?
ajay: I can take deploy. I'll be online from 23:20 PT and on-call until 01:00 PT.
skyler: Thanks — do we want to split by region or customer segment for first pass?
kim: Region-first makes sense to me. Start NA-west, then NA-east, then EU. Start very small (1%) in the first shard.
leo: I'll take smoke ownership. Quick ask: which metrics are the must-watch?
maria: Primary set: p50/p95 latency, request error-rate, tail token spend, and downstream queue depth. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fractional-rollout — thresholds are in the top section.
ajay: Rollback playbook (saved): `kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:v2.0 --namespace=prod`
ajay: Gateway rollback: `gatewayctl rollback --target v2.0 --region $REGION`
leo: Smoke commands I'll run from bastion: `scripts/smoke_infer.sh --model gpt-small --seq 512 --profile smoke` — that hits the exact endpoint the service uses.
skyler: Proposed manual ramp schedule (will hold between steps for metric checks):
```
23:30 PT -> NA-west -> 1% (10m)
23:40 PT -> NA-west -> 5% (10m)
23:50 PT -> NA-east -> 5% (10m)
00:00 PT -> EU -> 10% (15m)
00:15 PT -> global -> 50% (15m)
00:30 PT -> global -> 100%
```
kim: @ajay @leo when you start smokes please ping here with exactly `smoke OK` or `smoke FAIL` and paste the first 10 lines of logs if FAIL.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled by ajay for 2025-04-12 23:30 PT. CI checks passed. Rollback window = 60m.
ajay: Kicking off NA-west deploy in ~10. tagging @oncall-eng for alert coverage.
oncall-eng: I'll watch the alert channels. If error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m or p95 latency doubles, I'll call rollback.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll update the Console rollout policy (percent list + watch links) and create a trace link pre/post deploy.
leo: Clear — smoke script and log capture ready.
kim: Confirming no DB migrations or infra flags in this release. Model artifacts are staged in the prod bucket.
ajay: Starting deploy now. Will update with smoke status.
ajay: smoke OK — NA-west 1% probe passed, p95 stable, error-rate 0.02%. Moving to NA-west 5%.
maria: Thanks — proceeding on schedule. If anything odd appears, hit rollback and ping support line immediately.
